citation: Shaban et al., "Overlooked Ionic Contribution of a Chiral Dopant in Cholesteric Liquid Crystals", Materials 17, 5080 (2024), doi:10.3390/ma17205080 (Europe PMC PMC11509098)
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only
topic: The nematic E44 was doped with the chiral dopant R5011 (right-handed) or with its enantiomer S5011 (left-handed), and the mobile ions were measured by low-frequency dielectric spectroscopy.

facts.text: Adding R5011 (0 to 4 wt%) raises the mobile-ion density from 1.7 to 2.9 × 10^13 cm^-3, and the dielectric loss at 1 kHz grows linearly with R5011 content.
Adding S5011 (0 to 4 wt%) leaves the ion density at 1.6-1.9 × 10^13 cm^-3; the spectra overlap those of pure E44.
1:1 mixtures of R5011 and S5011 (no net chirality) at 1, 2 and 4 wt% in total give ion densities and diffusivities close to those of R5011-only samples at 0.5, 1 and 2 wt%.
Antiparallel (6 µm) and 90°-twisted (5 µm) cells with the same alignment layers and electrodes give the same ionic behaviour.
The R- and S-doped mixtures (2.62 and 2.57 wt%) have nearly the same helical pitch (0.355 and 0.362 µm) and nearly identical reflection bands.

ask: Which explanation of the extra ions is consistent with all of these observations?

hypotheses.text: Impurity ions carried by this batch of R5011 (from manufacture or later contamination or degradation), unrelated to its handedness.
hypotheses.locator: Section 3.3 and Conclusions: R5011 as received contained more impurity ions; handedness not associated with the ionic response
hypotheses.reason: 与全部观测一致，即原文结论。

hypotheses.text: The right-handed helical order itself generates or traps the ions.
hypotheses.locator: Section 3.3: racemic blends behave like R5011-only samples
hypotheses.reason: 外消旋混合物没有净螺旋，却与同剂量 R5011 相同，说明不是手性结构所致。

hypotheses.text: Any chiral dopant dissociates into ions in E44, whichever its handedness.
hypotheses.locator: Section 3.2: S5011 adds no appreciable ions
hypotheses.reason: S5011 同为手性剂，却几乎不增加离子。

hypotheses.text: The ions come from the cell (alignment layers and electrodes), and the cell geometry controls them.
hypotheses.reason: 两种盒子结果相同，且离子随 R5011 浓度线性增加，来源不是盒子。

scale.definition: 螺距 p（约 0.36 μm；离子问题的结构背景）
